ष्टु(ञ)ष्टुञ् r. 2nd cl. (स्तौति or स्तुते स्तवीति or स्तवीते)
 1. To praise, to
eulogise.
 2. To extol, to celebrate.
 3. To hymn, to worship with
praises. With सम्, 1. To praise.
 2. To be familiar with; also स्तु ।

ष्टुच् r. 1st cl. (स्तोचते) To be clear, to be bright, to be pellucid.
 2. To
be propitious or pleased; also स्तुच् ।
ष्टुप् r. 10th. cl. (स्तोपयति-ते) To heap up.

ष्टूप्(इ)ष्टूपि r. 4th cl. (स्तूप्यति) r. 10th cl. (स्तूपयति-ते) To heap together,
to pile up, to collect into a heap.
 2. To erect; also स्तूप् ।

ष्टुभ्(उ)ष्टुभु r. 1st cl. (स्तोभते)
 1. To stop, to hinder.
 2. To be stupid
or dull. (स्तोभति)
 1. To praise.
 2. To celebrate; also स्तुभ् ।
